description: This file implements a Discord inbound worker for processing messages, handling timeouts, and managing worker state within a larger application. It includes functions for processing jobs, handling timeouts, and creating worker instances.

methods.name: formatDiscordRunContextSuffix
methods.description: Formats a string suffix with message channel and message IDs for logging or error messages.

methods.name: processDiscordInboundJob
methods.description: Processes a Discord inbound job, managing message handling, timeouts, and error reporting.

methods.name: sendDiscordInboundWorkerTimeoutReply
methods.description: Sends a timeout reply message if the inbound worker times out, including error handling.

methods.name: createDiscordInboundWorker
methods.description: Creates and returns a Discord inbound worker with enqueue and deactivate methods.
